name: Omar Nair
headline: Platform Engineer
summary: Platform engineer focused on building reliable delivery pipelines, internal tooling and observability for product teams. Experience spans software delivery, containerized services and operational support in fast-moving engineering environments. Known for improving release flow, reducing manual effort and keeping platforms stable under load.

roles.title: Junior DevOps Engineer
bullets: Built CI/CD pipelines and improved Git-based release workflows, cutting deployment handoffs by 40%.
Automated build and release checks across the backend and support services, reducing manual intervention for 3 teams.
Partnered with engineers to standardize source control practices in Git and keep branch usage consistent across projects.

roles.title: Software Engineer
bullets: Developed Python services packaged with Docker and wired into CI/CD, supporting faster delivery for internal products.
Shaped MLOps workflows for model builds and promotion, improving repeatability across 2 environments.
Reduced failure recovery time by 35% by adding safer runtime checks and clearer deployment steps in Python services.
Worked with delivery pipelines to keep container images consistent and remove recurring release issues.

roles.title: Platform Engineer
bullets: Owns Docker-based platform components and GitHub Actions workflows that support daily releases across 5 services.
Built Python tooling for platform tasks and expanded Prometheus coverage to improve alert quality and reduce noisy incidents by 28%.
Developed Rust utilities for safer operational workflows and shared them across the team for reuse.
Tuned monitoring dashboards and alert thresholds in Prometheus so on-call engineers could spot service issues earlier.
Improved automation around image builds and delivery paths with Docker and GitHub Actions, lowering manual steps for the platform team.

projects.name: Rapid Inbox
projects.description: Built a reporting view in Grafana to help teams track service health and release trends. The dashboard combined Grafana panels with operational metrics for faster review.
